body.statement: Corollary 1 (Replay record). Every complete RankPeel run emits a transcript \(\mathcal T\) of \(O(p^3+p^2\log p)\) bits for which \(\operatorname{Verify}(P_X,R^{\mathrm{law}}_{P_X},\mathcal T,\widehat G)=1\). Replaying it uses at most \(p^2+p\) law-invariant oracle calls and \(O(p^3)\) bookkeeping; under Theorem 1 its recorded graph represents \(\theta_G\).
body.justification: The corollary records the decisions supporting a complete run without elevating deterministic replay into a separate identification theorem.
body.gap: The anchor does not package its exhaustive construction as a compact canonical query transcript.
body.consumer: An implementation can reproduce every population decision made by the deterministic protocol.
